description: This file defines the VariableCleanupRule class, a utility class that extends BaseRule to perform variable cleanup and transformation during the parsing of panel data for different views (DetailView and EditView) in SuiteCRM. It processes panel arrays to modify variable names based on certain patterns.

classes.name: VariableCleanupRule
classes.description: A utility class that refines variable names in panel data for different views, handling specific patterns for checkbox, parent, assigned user, and radio options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the VariableCleanupRule class, does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Processes panel data for specified views, modifying variable names according to predefined patterns such as converting checkbox suffixes, clearing parent/assigned user IDs, and handling radio options.
